import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def naive_search_precond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧ 
  needle.size < 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def naive_matches_at_bool (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) &&
    (List.range needle.size).all fun j =>
      decide (haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def naive_search (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (_ : naive_search_precond haystack needle) : Array Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter
    (naive_matches_at_bool haystack needle)).toArray
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matches_at (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ j, j < needle.size → haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def naive_search_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (result : Array Nat) (_ : naive_search_precond haystack needle) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i, i < result.size → matches_at haystack needle (result.getD i 0)) ∧
  (∀ i, matches_at haystack needle i → ∃ k, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k 0 = i)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem naive_matches_at_bool_eq_true_iff
    (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) :
    naive_matches_at_bool haystack needle i = true ↔
      matches_at haystack needle i := by
  simp [naive_matches_at_bool, matches_at]

theorem list_mem_iff_exists_toArray_getD
    {α : Type} (xs : List α) (x fallback : α) :
    x ∈ xs ↔
      ∃ k, k < xs.toArray.size ∧ xs.toArray.getD k fallback = x := by
  simp [Array.getD]
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons a xs ih =>
      constructor
      · intro hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with hxa | hx
        · subst x
          refine ⟨0, by simp, ?_⟩
          simp
        · rcases ih.mp hx with ⟨k, hk, hval⟩
          refine ⟨k + 1, by simpa using hk, ?_⟩
          have hval' : xs[k] = x := by
            simpa [hk] using hval
          simpa [hk] using hval'
      · rintro ⟨k, hk, hval⟩
        cases k with
        | zero =>
            apply List.mem_cons.mpr
            left
            simpa using hval.symm
        | succ k =>
            apply List.mem_cons.mpr
            right
            apply ih.mpr
            have hk' : k < xs.length := by
              simpa using hk
            refine ⟨k, hk', ?_⟩
            have hval' : xs[k] = x := by
              simpa [hk'] using hval
            simpa [hk'] using hval'
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem naive_search_postcond_satisfied (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (h_precond : naive_search_precond haystack needle) :
    naive_search_postcond haystack needle (naive_search haystack needle h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  constructor
  · intro k hk
    let xs :=
      (List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter
        (naive_matches_at_bool haystack needle)

    change k < xs.toArray.size at hk
    change matches_at haystack needle (xs.toArray.getD k 0)

    have hmem : xs.toArray.getD k 0 ∈ xs :=
      (list_mem_iff_exists_toArray_getD
        xs (xs.toArray.getD k 0) 0).2 ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩

    have hparts :
        xs.toArray.getD k 0 ∈ List.range (haystack.size + 1) ∧
          naive_matches_at_bool haystack needle
            (xs.toArray.getD k 0) = true := by
      simpa [xs] using hmem

    exact
      (naive_matches_at_bool_eq_true_iff
        haystack needle (xs.toArray.getD k 0)).1 hparts.2

  · intro i hi
    let xs :=
      (List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter
        (naive_matches_at_bool haystack needle)

    have hib :
        naive_matches_at_bool haystack needle i = true :=
      (naive_matches_at_bool_eq_true_iff haystack needle i).2 hi

    have hiBound : i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size := by
      exact hi.1

    have hiLe : i ≤ haystack.size := by
      omega

    have hirange : i ∈ List.range (haystack.size + 1) := by
      simp only [List.mem_range]
      exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le hiLe

    have himem : i ∈ xs := by
      simp only [xs, List.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨hirange, hib⟩

    change ∃ k, k < xs.toArray.size ∧ xs.toArray.getD k 0 = i
    exact (list_mem_iff_exists_toArray_getD xs i 0).1 himem
  -- !benchmark @end proof
